conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced upside potential in exchange for greater stability.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It concentrates in high-scoring setups and uses leverage, increasing both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of significant daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly honored.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income-generating ETFs and broad index, cutting high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
